summary.limitation: Fixed co-adapted KeyOnly content sensitivity preserving the actually available tap sum. Original kernel is unchanged; off effective current coefficient changes. Latent constant gain is preserved, not output norm, direction or memory attention allocation. Current-only gain is absorbable at function level, not equivalent optimization or retraining. This is not a new CNN contribution, original CNN, or a retrained model. No causal, generalization or significance claim.
